en: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a woman in a historical costume, standing in front of a decorative tapestry. The woman is identified as Gertrud Strelewitz, playing the role of Ophelia. The overall look and style suggest it is a theatrical or promotional postcard from an earlier era. There is text in German identifying the actress and the role, as well as a photographer's credit at the bottom.
